inference: Exploratory post-OFAT combinations, three paired seeds. Combined-versus-base performance is not proof of interaction. Four-corner paired contrasts are identifiable only on tail cases with existing simple effects. No significance or holdout claim; historical controls belong to a prior stage.
timing_scope: Full per-cell search wall budget. Nominal observations exclude overshoot. Misses are censored at their own horizon. No pooled mixed-budget time.
